items.context: LINEARCERAM's thin design harmonizes with any space. Sophisticated and inviting to use, LINEARCERAM is a new paradigm in bathroom aesthetics. To create a vessel of such exquisite thinness, TOTO developed an advanced form of proprietary ceramic which is eye-catchingly thin but also extremely strong at the same time.
